answer: Each challenge binds its parameters and commit deadline to a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so its unpredictable output selects the task only after identities and commitments are fixed. A shale sample, prism path, or vertex relation may define the work, but answers cannot be precomputed for that pulse or cheaply farmed offline across sybils; rate limits and verifiable resource costs still enforce one-work-per-identity constraints.
